006package dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema;
007
008import java.io.IOException;
009import java.net.URI;
010import java.util.List;
011import java.util.Map;
012import java.util.stream.Collectors;
013
014import dev.metaschema.core.configuration.IConfiguration;
015import dev.metaschema.core.configuration.IMutableConfiguration;
016import dev.metaschema.core.model.AbstractModuleLoader;
017import dev.metaschema.core.model.MetaschemaException;
018import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
019import dev.metaschema.databind.IBindingContext;
020import dev.metaschema.databind.io.DeserializationFeature;
021import dev.metaschema.databind.io.IBoundLoader;
022import dev.metaschema.databind.model.IBoundDefinitionModelAssembly;
023import dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema.binding.METASCHEMA;
024import dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema.binding.METASCHEMA.Import;
025import dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema.impl.BindingModule;
026import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
027import nl.talsmasoftware.lazy4j.Lazy;
028
029/**
030 * A module loader implementation that parses Metaschema modules from a
031 * specified resource using the built-in model {@link MetaschemaModelModule}
032 * binding.
033 * <p>
034 * Metaschema modules loaded this way are automatically registered with the
035 * {@link IBindingContext}.
036 * <p>
037 * Use of this Metaschema module loader requires that the associated binding
038 * context is initialized using a {@link IModuleLoaderStrategy} that supports
039 * dynamic bound module loading. This can be accomplished using the
040 * {@link SimpleModuleLoaderStrategy} initialized using the
041 * {@link DefaultModuleBindingGenerator}.
042 */
043/**
044 * Loads Metaschema modules from XML or YAML sources using data binding.
045 * <p>
046 * This class provides functionality to parse Metaschema module files and
047 * construct the corresponding module model.
048 */
049public class BindingModuleLoader
050    extends AbstractModuleLoader<METASCHEMA, IBindingMetaschemaModule>
051    implements IBindingModuleLoader {
052  private final Lazy<IBoundLoader> loader;
053  private final ModuleLoadingPostProcessor postProcessor;
054
055  /**
056   * Construct a new Metaschema loader.
057   *
058   * @param bindingContext
059   *          the Metaschema binding context used to load bound resources
060   * @param postProcessor
061   *          the post processor to use when after loading a module
062   */
063  public BindingModuleLoader(
064      @NonNull IBindingContext bindingContext,
065      @NonNull ModuleLoadingPostProcessor postProcessor) {
066    this.loader = Lazy.of(bindingContext::newBoundLoader);
067    this.postProcessor = postProcessor;
068  }
069
070  @Override
071  @NonNull
072  public IBindingContext getBindingContext() {
073    return getLoader().getBindingContext();
074  }
075
076  @Override
077  protected IBindingMetaschemaModule newModule(
078      URI resource,
079      METASCHEMA binding,
080      List<? extends IBindingMetaschemaModule> importedModules)
081      throws MetaschemaException {
082    IBindingContext bindingContext = getLoader().getBindingContext();
083
084    IBindingMetaschemaModule module = new BindingModule(
085        resource,
086        ObjectUtils.notNull(
087            (IBoundDefinitionModelAssembly) bindingContext.getBoundDefinitionForClass(METASCHEMA.class)),
088        binding,
089        importedModules);
090
091    // post-process the module
092    postProcessor.postProcessModule(module, bindingContext);
093    return module;
094  }
095
096  @Override
097  protected List<URI> getImports(METASCHEMA binding) {
098    return ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getImports().stream()
099        .map(Import::getHref)
100        .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList()));
101  }
102
103  @Override
104  protected METASCHEMA parseModule(URI resource) throws IOException {
105    return getLoader().load(METASCHEMA.class, resource);
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Get the underlying bound loader.
110   *
111   * @return the loader
112   */
113  protected IBoundLoader getLoader() {
114    return ObjectUtils.notNull(loader.get());
115  }
116
117  @Override
118  public boolean isFeatureEnabled(DeserializationFeature<?> feature) {
119    return getLoader().isFeatureEnabled(feature);
120  }
121
122  @Override
123  public Map<DeserializationFeature<?>, Object> getFeatureValues() {
124    return getLoader().getFeatureValues();
125  }
126
127  @Override
128  public IMutableConfiguration<DeserializationFeature<?>>
129      applyConfiguration(IConfiguration<DeserializationFeature<?>> other) {
130    return getLoader().applyConfiguration(other);
131  }
132
133  @Override
134  public IMutableConfiguration<DeserializationFeature<?>> set(DeserializationFeature<?> feature, Object value) {
135    return getLoader().set(feature, value);
136  }
137
138  /**
139   * Allow inline XML entities to be automatically replaced.
140   */
141  @Override
142  public void allowEntityResolution() {
143    enableFeature(DeserializationFeature.DESERIALIZE_XML_ALLOW_ENTITY_RESOLUTION);
144  }
145}
